description_en: Enables the traffic mirroring feature for a service. After the feature is enabled, requests received by the service can be mirrored to another service
description_zh: 开启服务流量镜像功能，可以将一个服务接受到的请求镜像到另一个服务上
kebab_example: aliyun eas create-service-mirror --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --ratio 30 --target echo --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateServiceMirror
